mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, potentially potentiating irbesartan's hypotensive effects and increasing risk of hypertensive crisis if sympathomimetic amines are present or tyramine-rich foods consumed.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution; if necessary, monitor blood pressure closely and counsel patient on tyramine restriction; consider alternative antidepressant with lower interaction potential.
